title: 禁止 Python 與 Node；套件管理下載僅限 Visual Studio Installer 與 Winget
summary: Human-governor directive 2026-09-28: Python and Node are forbidden with no download, install, execution, residency or transitional period; package-management downloads use exactly two channels, Visual Studio Installer and Winget; language package managers (Cargo, Go modules, NuGet, npm, pip and successors) never perform a network download and may use only vendored or already-registered artifacts inside the managed dependency root; anything neither channel can provide requires an explicit permission artifact. Codex-only change: no implementation is migrated by this request.
origin: human-governor directive: 套件管理下載只能 Visual Studio 與 Winget

problem.summary: The published generation allows language package managers to manage project-local dependency artifacts without an explicit download-channel restriction; the governor limits package downloads to Visual Studio Installer and Winget.

changes.proposed:
PACKAGE-VERSION-SYNC:the automation core owns periodic package version reconciliation as a registered periodic flow: detect installed toolchain and package versions across every governed surface (vendored toolchains, language runtimes, dependency manifests, services), run governed upgrades through Winget where one exists under policy bounds,with Visual Studio Installer as the only other authorized download channel;language package managers (Cargo,Go modules,NuGet,npm,pip and successors) never perform a network download and may use only vendored or already-registered dependency artifacts inside the registered dependency root;components installed through the Visual Studio Installer (MSVC toolset,Windows SDK and VS-managed build components) remain a registered exception, and reconcile declared codex versions to installed actuals by emitting codex-amendment-request artifacts through the governed intake pipeline -- never by direct authority writes; upgrades are fail-closed when the ecosystem is offline or vendored.

PACKAGE-AUTO-DEFER:每24小時偵測一次。未具明確新增套件許可者自動標記DEFERRED_AWAITING_PERMISSION；一般新版發布未滿14日者自動標記DEFERRED_OBSERVATION_WINDOW。遞延不等於拒絕、通過或已安裝，遞延期間禁止下載、安裝、鎖定或執行；條件成熟後於下一次週期自動重新評估。重大安全或相容性事件得立即加跑受管檢查。

DEPENDENCY-AUTHORITY:automation-core automatically updates registered dependency versions but cannot admit a new dependency identity/source/runtime without current explicit permission artifact. ADMISSION:request declares purpose+owner+consumers+alternatives+direct/transitive graph+source+exact candidate+license+security+privilege/network/data/resource footprint; permission-core allow/deny precedes any fetch/install/lock/execute. UPDATE:registered identity follows 14-day normal rule or verified emergency exception and all gates;every package download uses exactly Visual Studio Installer or Winget;language package managers never perform a network download and use only vendored or already-registered artifacts;a package neither channel can provide requires an explicit permission artifact;Python and Node.js are forbidden:no download,install,execution,residency or transitional period. RETIREMENT:consumer cutover+stability+zero active consumer+zero lock/manifest/runtime reference+data/config migration+bounded rollback retention+purge receipt; terminal PURGED means no binary,package,cache,environment,model artifact or executable reference remains. INVENTORY:current+rollback-only+retirement state machine machine-readable.; UPDATE-DETECTION:every-24-hours+immediate-governed-security-advisory-event; RETIREMENT-TAG:mandatory from SUPERSEDED through PURGE_READY and binds dependency-id+old-version+successor-version+state+reason+zero-consumer-progress+rollback-deadline+scheduled-purge-at
